verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents a prefunded Issuing balance that you top up by pushing funds from an external bank account. Its synchronous webhook lets your system approve or decline each authorization in real time, but nothing in the evidence shows just-in-time funding of individual authorizations or a choice between funding models. Missing for 10: documented just-in-time funding where each authorization is funded on approval, a documented choice between funding models, documentation of the cash-flow tradeoffs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can choose how transactions are funded — prefunded balances or just-in-time funding where my system approves and funds each authorization — with the cash-flow tradeoffs documented

citations.quote: Using the Stripe Dashboard or API, you can access the bank account and routing information you need to push funds from your external bank account.
Using the synchronous webhook, you can approve or decline authorization requests in real time.
